title: Orbit Board v1.2.3 (Stable)
changelog: Instant Bengali Number Pad Switcher: Dialpad now includes a dedicated shortcut key (১২৩ / 123) to switch instantly between English and Bengali digits with long-press moreKeys.
Real-Time Interactive Keyboard Resizer: Live visual feedback and preview while adjusting keyboard height and bottom padding without guessing.
Adaptive Spacebar Accent: Spacebar color dynamically inherits the active theme's accent color (Enter & Emoji keys) with clean custom border options.
Voice Typing Microphone Click Sound Toggle: Option to easily mute/unmute audio feedback click when activating microphone.
Push Update Notifications: Integrated background WorkManager update checker alerting users through system notifications when a new version is released.
Native Bengali Suite: Full Avro Phonetic, Probhat with [ ্য | য | র্য ] popup panel, Jatiyo Modern, Jatiyo Classic, and Alphabetical Bangla layouts.
Performance & Stability: Fixed crash reports on specific devices and optimized input memory footprint.
